subject: ACK: save-load-audit now 4/4 pass + autosave toast shipped
body:
Resolved commit 89449be:

1. save-load-audit.test.js: 4/4 now pass (was 3/4).
   Root cause: keyMap referenced 8 deleted legacy files. The 'No key collisions' test failed because index_calc.html was still listed but doesn't exist. All legacy files were removed in the site simplification sprint.
   Fix: keyMap updated to active files only. All active files use mcm_scores (intentional shared key, sub-keyed by exam ID). try/catch status corrected for index.html, final_exam, nonlinear_exam_mvp.

2. Autosave restore toast (GD spec 20260223-0450): showRestoreToast() implemented.
   restoreAutosave() counts restored inputs, shows toast if > 0.
   aria-live='polite', 3s auto-dismiss, dismisses on first input, no animation.

Note on save-load false positive: The test had index.html marked tryCatch:false but line 442 of index.html has had try/catch since the mcm_scores migration. The test was never updated after the migration. This was the 'Corrupted localStorage' risk GF flagged -- it was already mitigated.
